title: Codify CEO Mandate 77: one isolated working directory per agent (agent roots)
goal: CEO directive 2026-11-12: every agent must work in its own isolated Susi working directory, with a root context per agent so agents never create the same local working directory. Author docs/ceo-mandate-77.md (one root per agent per machine, everything created lives under it, never write in another agent's root, what stays shared, implementation truth), register Mandate 77 in .agents/identity.json, make it discoverable from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and README.md, and guard it in tests/architecture_tests.rs. The enforcing tool is Commercial T-CLAUDECOMMAGENTROOT-1.
limitations: Governance text and a discoverability test in this repository; the root tool and its enforcement live in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps.
A checkout in no registered root is reported, not refused; plain file edits and builds outside the workflow tool are not enforced.
